name: Intercom

prompts.text: Summarize the open conversations from the last 24 hours.
Show the recent conversations and tickets for this customer email.
What are the most common topics in this week's support conversations?

description: Intercom lets agents search and read conversations, tickets, and contacts in the signed-in workspace. Each user signs in to their own Intercom account through the browser; this address is for US-hosted workspaces.
